payload.markdown:
# Investigation report: OTP logins failing

**Outcome:** inconclusive · **Stop reason:** budget_tool_calls · **Confidence:** 0.65 · **Written by:** baseline agent

## Summary
Beginning at approximately 05:10 UTC (10:40 IST) on 2026-10-16, OTP login success dropped from ~97% to ~70%, with auth-service error rate jumping from 0.5% to 4.5%. Investigation ruled out the reporter's suspected causes (sms-provider and notification-service), which showed normal delivery rates and flat error metrics. However, an infrastructure change at 04:54 UTC upgrading the log shipper on the auth-service node pool broke auth-service log ingestion, leaving internal failure details unobservable.

**Root cause:** The exact root cause within auth-service cannot be definitively established due to a lack of application logs following an infrastructure log-shipper upgrade at 04:54 UTC (CHG-48221). However, the failure is localized to auth-service OTP verification (otp_success_rate dropped to ~70%, error rate spiked to ~4.5% starting at 05:10 UTC), while sms-provider and notification-service are conclusively ruled out.

## Hypotheses
1. **Host-level issue or clock skew introduced during or following node pool log-shipper upgrade (CHG-48221) on auth-service causing OTP verification failures** — `auth-service`, infrastructure_failure, confidence 0.65, plausible
   - Supporting: [ev_1, ev_3, ev_6, ev_7, ev_8] · Contradicting: none
   - auth-service error rate rose and OTP success rate dropped to ~70% approximately 16 minutes after an infrastructure upgrade on auth-service's node pool (CHG-48221), which also disabled log shipping. Elevated verification failure rate with normal SMS delivery strongly points to internal validation errors on auth-service instances.
2. **SMS provider outage or notification delivery failure causing OTP drop** — `sms-provider`, upstream_dependency_degradation, confidence 0.05, ruled_out
   - Supporting: none · Contradicting: [ev_4, ev_5, ev_13]
   - The reporter suspected sms-provider / notification-service, but sms_send_failures remained flat (2-4/min), notification-service error rate stayed at 0.3%, and notification logs show OTP SMS accepted normally.

## Facts
- auth-service otp_success_rate dropped from ~97.4% to 87.04% at 05:10 UTC and remained degraded at ~68%–72% through 07:00 UTC. [ev_3]
- auth-service error_rate rose from baseline ~0.5% to ~4.5% starting at 05:10 UTC and stayed elevated throughout the window. [ev_6]
- notification-service sms_send_failures remained normal (2–4/min), error_rate remained stable at ~0.3%, and SMS messages were accepted normally by sms-provider. [ev_4, ev_5, ev_13]
- At 2026-10-16 04:54:00 UTC, change CHG-48221 upgraded the log shipper agent on the auth-service node pool (v2.8 -> v3.0). [ev_1]
- auth-service logs ceased appearing in the log collection system after 04:54:07 UTC. [ev_7, ev_8]
- Shared cache hit rates/evictions and database metrics (request rate, slow queries, CPU) remained within healthy baseline ranges. [ev_10, ev_11, ev_23, ev_24]

## Inferences
- The SMS provider and notification pipeline operated normally; OTP codes were successfully dispatched to users. [ev_4, ev_5, ev_13]
- CHG-48221 (log shipper v2.8 -> v3.0 on auth-service node pool) caused log shipper failure on auth-service nodes, cutting off log telemetry at 04:54:07 UTC. [ev_1, ev_7, ev_8]
- The login failures are caused by OTP verification errors within auth-service itself, rather than delivery failures. [ev_3, ev_6]

## Assumptions
- Users receive OTP SMS messages promptly, but verification fails during code submission at auth-service.

## Timeline
- **2026-10-16T04:54:00.000Z** CHG-48221 upgrades log shipper agent (v2.8 -> v3.0) on auth-service node pool [ev_1]
- **2026-10-16T04:54:07.000Z** auth-service log ingestion stops abruptly following the shipper upgrade [ev_7, ev_8]
- **2026-10-16T05:10:00.000Z** auth-service error_rate increases from ~0.5% to ~2.16% and otp_success_rate falls to 87.04% [ev_3, ev_6]
- **2026-10-16T05:15:00.000Z** auth-service otp_success_rate drops to ~71.99% and error_rate stabilizes at ~4.5% [ev_3, ev_6]
- **2026-10-16T05:50:00.000Z** On-call SRE opens INC-6097 reporting OTP login failures, suspecting SMS provider [ev_3, ev_4]

## Confidence
0.65: The evidence conclusively rules out the reporter's suspected cause (sms-provider / notification-service outage), and pinpoints auth-service as the failing component starting at 05:10 UTC. However, because auth-service log shipping broke at 04:54 UTC following an agent upgrade, direct log evidence of the internal failure reason within auth-service is missing, precluding a definitive root cause.

## Gaps
- auth-service application logs are missing from 04:54:07 UTC onwards due to log-shipper failure following CHG-48221. (impact: Cannot inspect the exact application error messages or stack traces generated during failed OTP verifications.)
- No node-level system metrics (such as host clock offset/NTP sync or container restarts) are available in the metric catalog. (impact: Cannot directly confirm whether clock skew or host-level disruption on the auth-service node pool caused OTP validation to fail.)

## Tool failures
- query_metrics {"service":"auth-service","metric":"otp_success_rate","from":"2026-10-16T04:30:00.000Z","to":"2026-10-16T07:00:00.000Z","aggregation":"avg","group_by":"region"}: invalid_input: metric auth-service/otp_success_rate cannot be grouped by "region". Available labels: (none) (1 attempts)
- search_incidents {"limit":5}: invalid_input: give at least one of "services" or "text" (1 attempts)

## Recommended actions (not executed)
- **[now]** Investigate and fix the log-shipper agent on the auth-service node pool to restore auth-service logging. [ev_1, ev_7, ev_8]
  - Why: Restoring application logs is critical to inspect the exact exceptions and reasons for auth-service OTP verification failures.
  - Verify: Verify query_logs returns active log streams for auth-service with status and error fields.
- **[now]** Check NTP synchronization and system clocks across all nodes in the auth-service node pool. [ev_1, ev_3, ev_6]
  - Why: Clock drift on node pool instances following the 04:54 UTC node agent update can cause time-sensitive OTP validation or token expiration checks to fail on a subset of nodes.
  - Verify: Run chronyc or ntpstat on all auth-service nodes to verify clock offset is < 50ms across the pool.
- **[next]** Perform a rolling restart of auth-service pods/instances across the node pool. [ev_3, ev_6]
  - Why: Clears any poisoned local state, dead connections, or skewed daemon configurations on the affected node pool.
  - Verify: Monitor otp_success_rate on auth-service returning to >= 97% baseline.

Cited evidence: ev_1, ev_3, ev_4, ev_5, ev_6, ev_7, ev_8, ev_10, ev_11, ev_13, ev_23, ev_24
Investigation window: 2026-10-16 10:00 IST to 2026-10-16 12:30 IST
